caption: Carnage from last week at @ecstaticdance.uk with @dominika_mak supporting. It was a deep and wild one. Thanks to everyone who made it such a powerful night!
Another clip of @innschris playing with the latest iteration of my Sangha Looper. Psychedelic and exploratory - I think we have the makings of an improvised dance set 😃 ... Can't wait to try it out!

Fun times today with @innschris testing out the latest iteration of my Sangha Looper. Psychedelic and exploratory - I think we have the makings of an improvised dance set 😃 ... Can't wait to try it out!

I've been taking a step back from DJing for a bit this summer to work on some new music, but excited to announce I'm back with a few gigs booked:
😈 ED Brighton, Fri Oct 6th (Shadow Rave) 
🌙 ED UK, Wed Oct 28th
🐉 ED Wales, Jan '27

Such a blast playing with the supremely talented @phoebegarratt this afternoon. Multiplayer loops with Sangha Looper, think we're getting near to a V1 now! I just need to sort out my Apple developer account and I can share it with you all properly. #loopstation

Celebrating my DJ debut at @ecstaticdance.uk 3 years ago today! Here's @dominika_mak bringing us home a couple of weeks ago, with a live version of a track we collaborated on. It was a quiet storm in the peak of a heatwave, hottest dance of the year and my favourite one so far. Full set on my SoundCloud 😊
